item.content:encoded:
When not active, SCP-672 polyps completely seal themselves within their shells and become nearly impossible to distinguish from surrounding rock formations.

Oh god, it could be anywhere. Upvoted.

The only thing that I would want to be changed would be this bit here:

can only be distinguished from deposits formed by normal coral by the presence of [DATA EXPUNGED].

Considering that it's stated to be almost identical to normal coral deposits, I doubt that anything seriously nasty is being hidden behind the [DATA EXPUNGED]. As such, I think it would be less… dramatic1 as a [REDACTED] instead of a [DATA EXPUNGED].

Footnotes
1. how do I shot adjective
